pages.text: With water consumption enabled, farmland no longer stays wet forever.$(br2)Crops on farmland $(bold)drink water$() from nearby water sources. At each 6:00 settlement, water is drained from the sources that serve planted fields.$(br2)Only $(info)still water source blocks$() count. Flowing water does not.

pages.title: Service quota
pages.text: One water source keeps $(thing)waterPerSource$() (default 10) farmland plots watered, choosing the nearest plots first.$(br2)Adjacent water sources merge into a $(bold)pond$() and share their quota.$(br2)If the field has no crop, no water is drained.

pages.title: Replenishing
pages.text: Vanilla infinite water is $(warn)disabled$(): a drained source does not refill by itself.$(br2)Pour a new water bucket to restore a source. Re-poured water is a brand new source and re-computes which fields it serves.$(br2)Rain can also save your crops - see Rain Growth.$(br2)Rivers, oceans and natural water are $(bold)consumed just the same$() - no water is free. See "How Much Water Is Drawn" for the daily amount and refilling.
